title: CLI action classification
responsibility: Reduces CLI arguments to the known command action used for attribution.

inputs.name: commandAction.args
inputs.description: CLI arguments beginning with the command and optional subcommand; executable and script names should already be removed.

outputs.name: commandAction
outputs.description: Known top-level action, known command plus subcommand, command plus help for an unknown subcommand, or help-or-unknown for an unrecognized top-level command.
